children: said on Wednesday it has reduced a number of roles in its technology team in India as part of efforts to simplify operations.
"The impact of these changes is less than 20% of our India Technology organization," the company said in a statement.
The German sportswear maker did not disclose how many jobs were affected. Its website showed nearly 650 people worked at its Gurgaon and Chennai hubs.
